messages:
maya: FYI — we're seeing a sharp increase in SSO auth failures starting ~10:02 UTC, coincident with the KMS rotation for secret 'session_tokens_v2'. Lots of MFA prompts and some lockouts. Going to tag infra and sec.

sec-bot: Alert: 504 SSO auth_failures in 12m, anomalous spike vs baseline (3σ). Correlation: KMS rotate job #rot-2026-03-22-1000. https://internal.monitoring/redwood/alerts/504

ranjit: @maya can you paste the failed auth error? stack/message?

maya: here's the error we see in auth logs:

maya: ```ERROR: session_decrypt_failed: key_id=old-key-abc not found during decrypt for session_id=abcd1234...```

olivia: looks like tokens encrypted with previous key couldn't decrypt after rotation — session tokens aren't being re-encrypted. Did rotation clear key aliases?

noah: Running query on audit logs for key operations…

noah: ```-- kms_audit results
op, key_id, ts
RotateKey, new-key-def, 2026-03-22T10:01:12Z
UpdateAlias, new-key-def -> session_tokens_v2, 2026-03-22T10:01:15Z
ScheduleDelete, old-key-abc, 2026-03-22T10:03:05Z
```

ranjit: ScheduleDelete on old-key-abc? That's bad if alias was moved before re-encrypt. @olivia did rotation script remove alias early?

olivia: We updated alias then scheduled old key for deletion as part of the automation. The re-encrypt job should have run after alias update, but the job failed with transient network error.

maya: So tokens encrypted with old key try decrypt and fail because alias points to new key. That explains 'key not found' errors.

ranjit: Immediate action: pause rotation automation, cancel pending key deletion if possible, and enable fallback to decrypt-using-old-key via key ID mapping. @sec-bot run containment checklist.

sec-bot: Containment actions enqueued: 1) Pause rotation job; 2) Attempt cancel pending delete for old-key-abc; 3) Add temporary rule in auth-service to accept legacy decryption using old-key-abc; 4) Notify affected tenant apps. ETA 10m.

noah: I pushed a hotfix in auth-service to allow decryption by raw key id lookup while we recover. Deployed to canary. Logs show decrypt success rates improving (from ~60% -> ~92% in canary).

maya: User comms: we need short message for status page + internal comms. Suggest: 'We are investigating increased MFA prompts and login errors. No evidence of account compromise. Temporary mitigation in place.'

sarah: I'll draft status page and incident banner. Also recommend forcing short-lived session revoke for long-tail tokens once we re-encrypt to ensure no stale tokens remain.

olivia: Re-encrypt job re-run scheduled now with backoff fixes. Will post progress.

ranjit: Post-incident: update playbook: ensure alias move happens only after re-encrypt success; don't schedule delete in same window; add smoke test for decrypt after alias change; add alert for KMS ScheduleDelete events. Also ensure RBAC for rotation automation limited to ops group.

maya: Also add audit logging for re-encrypt success per tenant. We'll include runbook step to pause rotation if re-encrypt fails >3 retries.

noah: Forensics: no signs of lateral activity; auth anomalies all decryption errors. Will collect session ids and revoke long-lived tokens once re-encrypted.

sarah: Sending status update now. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
